population: train2863 examples contributing at least one strict 0.90 boundary state
scoring: D1A force attainable 0.90 active with unchanged multi-anchor mean residual

rules.top6_parent_rescue: top 6 globally then best child from up to two unrepresented parents
rules.parent_balanced: best child from each current parent before global fill
rules.random_parent_control: top 6 globally then two randomly selected unrepresented parents with fixed per-example seed

selection: rules fixed before replay; no post-result composition or parameter tuning
